properties.description: Bridge Maintenance Operations on LA-182 Both Directions from Berwick Bay to Federal Ave.  All lanes closed. Additional Restrictions: Vehicle Restriction No Access For Emergency Starting 5/22/2023 7:00 AM
properties.details:
ST. MARY PARISH, La. - The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (LADOTD) announces that beginning Monday, May 22, work will begin on a $25,969,337.50 rehabilitation project on the La. 182 bridge over the Atchafalaya River in St. Mary Parish.

The project will begin at the Berwick side and end at the Morgan City side of the bridge.

Work will consist of cleaning, painting, bridge repair, and related work.

Work is expected to take place Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., weather permitting. Nighttime and weekend work is also expected.

The bridge will be closed to traffic beginning May 23. The detour route will consist of U.S. 90.

Emergency vehicles will not have access to the area.

DOTD appreciates your patience and reminds you to please drive with caution through the construction site and be on the lookout for work crews and their equipment.

properties.details:

LA 404 will have a full closure beginning Wednesday, September 10th, 2025 at 7:00 AM between LA 993 and LA 3001. No thru traffic will be allowed at this time. 

Motorists can take the following State detour: 

From LA 404 Eastbound: Motorist traveling LA 404 EB should detour left onto LA 993 NB. Take a right onto LA 1 SB, followed by another right on LA 69 SB. At the intersection of LA 69 and LA 404, take a right onto LA 404 WB to complete the detour. 

From LA 404 Westbound: On LA 69, bypass LA 404 and travel LA 69 NB towards LA 1. Take a left onto LA 1 NB, followed by another left onto LA 993 SB. At the intersection of LA 993 and LA 404, take a left onto LA 404 to complete the detour. 

This full closure is to replace a bridge between LA 993 and LA 3001.

DOTD appreciates your patience and reminds you to please drive with caution through work zones and be on the lookout for work crews and their equipment.

properties.details:

The project will include clearing and grubbing, removal of precast slab span concrete bridges, grading, treated subgrade layer, class II base course, drainage structures, pavement patching, asphalt concrete pavement, steel sheeting, precast concrete piles, concrete slab span bridges, and related work.

The work is estimated to take place Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., weather permitting.

Bridge closures are expected throughout the project. The Department will publish additional press releases for these planned bridge closures.

The project is estimated for completion in spring 2028.

properties.details:
DOTD announces the upcoming replacement of a bridge on Ches Courville Road, 0.10 miles south of LA 352 (Henderson Highway) in St. Martin Parish.

The project, part of DOTD’s Off-System Bridge Program, represents an investment of approximately $1.59 million.

Construction is scheduled to begin Monday, November 2, 2026. The project includes the removal of the existing timber bridges, installation of a new concrete slab-span bridge, and associated roadway work.

The closure is expected to remain in place through Thursday, April 2027, to allow crews to safely remove and replace the existing bridge.

No detour route will be posted, and emergency vehicles will not have access through the construction area. Motorists should plan accordingly and seek alternate routes.

The project is anticipated to be completed in May 2027, weather permitting.

properties.description: Bridge Maintenance Operations on LA-29 Both Directions from Bayou Cocodrie to I-49 Southbound . Lane Intermittent. Width Restriction: 12ft Starting 10/19/2026 7:00 AM
properties.details:
DOTD announces that construction recently began on a $430,168.05 scour repair project on LA 29 over Bayou Cocodrie in St. Landry Parish. The project will address a 0.1-mile section of the roadway and bridge area.

As part of the project, crews will perform clearing and grubbing, install geotextile fabric and riprap, replace bridge joint material, seal joints, and complete related repairs.

By addressing scour and repairing bridge joints, this project will help protect the bridge infrastructure, reduce the potential for further erosion-related damage, and support the long-term reliability of this transportation route.
 The project is estimated to be completed in winter 2026.

Motorists should expect intermittent lane closures on LA 29 over Bayou Cocodrie throughout the project, which may cause delays. The roadway will remain open to regular traffic through the work zone, with a maximum lane restriction of 12 feet for oversized loads traveling through the area.

The intermittent closures are necessary to allow crews to complete bridge joint repairs and related work
